name: Herman Moll, Chili, Magellans-land, and Terra del Fuego, in A System of Geography (London, 1701), p. 214 (NYPL 1505157)
holding: New York Public Library, Lionel Pincus and Princess Firyal Map Division, image 1505157
note: 4536x6299. 'Davis's Land' at x 1040-1220, y 1300-1470: Moll's own redrawing of the coast he engraved for Dampier's New Voyage (1697), at four times the size: a shaded stroke bent like a check mark, with an oval islet - a pale core in a ring of hatching - in the crook on its sea side. Used ONLY for the islet (Wafer's 'small, sandy island'), which Vaugondy leaves out. Etienne's choice, October 2026.
equirectangular_note: Ticks read off the border: 285 and 290 at x 1062 and 1420 on the top border; 30 to 55 S at y 1464 to 3570 on the east border. Lon and lat scales differ (71.6 against 84.2 px per degree, a plate carree drawn for about 32 S), so km are taken separately in x and y. Used only for the islet's size and its distance off the coast.
